description: This is a Java test class for the AnySoftKeyboard project, specifically testing keyboard subtypes and input method interactions using Robolectric and Mockito frameworks.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardKeyboardSubtypeTest
classes.description: A test class extending AnySoftKeyboardBaseTest, containing multiple unit tests for keyboard subtype reporting and switching logic.

methods.name: testSubtypeReported
methods.description: Verifies that the keyboard subtype is correctly reported with expected locale and extra value.

methods.name: testAvailableSubtypesReported
methods.description: Checks that all available subtypes are reported correctly, including their IDs and locale matching.

methods.name: testAvailableSubtypesReportedWithLanguageTag
methods.description: Ensures that subtypes include correct language tags when running on API level N or higher.

methods.name: testKeyboardSwitchedOnCurrentInputMethodSubtypeChanged
methods.description: Tests that the keyboard switches appropriately when the current input method subtype changes.

methods.name: testKeyboardDoesNotSwitchOnCurrentSubtypeReported
methods.description: Verifies that the keyboard does not switch if the reported subtype matches the current one.

methods.name: testKeyboardDoesNotSwitchOnDelayedSubtypeReported
methods.description: Ensures that delayed subtype reports do not cause unnecessary keyboard switches.

methods.name: testKeyboardDoesSwitchIfNoDelayedSubtypeReported
methods.description: Checks that the keyboard switches when no delayed subtype report is received.

methods.name: testKeyboardSwitchOnUserSubtypeChanged
methods.description: Verifies that user-initiated subtype changes cause the keyboard to switch accordingly.
